NASAOfficialTwoMissionAndSelection.scopedInterviewExcerpt: Host: And last but not least, we have Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev, also a mission specialist for Crew-6, working with the commander and the pilot to monitor the spacecraft during all of those dynamic launch and re-entry phases of the flight. He’s also going to become a flight engineer once they’re onboard the space station. He was selected to become a cosmonaut in 2012 and has been patiently waiting for his first trip into space. He’s about to become the second cosmonaut to fly aboard Dragon and fulfill what he talked about as a lifelong ambition to fly in space. So let’s meet our fourth and final member of Crew-6, Andrey Fedyaev. Enjoy.
